context: Work only in fixture copies until the canary phase. Compare each current-state statement against current repository instructions/code or reclassify it as a dated observation. Replace imperative historical prose with typed observation/recommendation/history fields. Keep startup MEMORY.md files concise and project-specific. Sensitive operations may retain only a redacted pointer to a protected runbook.
description: Create a candidate Claude Code auto-memory treatment without mutating live memory. Remove the unconditional auto-commit/push mandate from automatic context; sanitize or remove private service endpoints, credential-minting instructions, credential-file locations, and private-repository operational details; correct or expire stale BenchBox version, lint-gate, YAML-index, release, test-count, and MCP-surface claims; make every MEMORY.md description derive from topic metadata so the index cannot say todo-db v0.2.0 while its topic says v0.3.0; move todo-db and skill-sync facts out of the over-broad /Users/joe memory root into their exact repository identities or delete them when current docs already own the fact; resolve the orphan QuestDB topic; add provenance, authority, freshness, sensitivity, supersession, and completion metadata. Preserve Claude's useful per-Git-repository startup index and on-demand topic loading.

anti_patterns.dont: fix an index description without fixing or expiring its linked topic
anti_patterns.instead: derive the index from validated topic metadata
anti_patterns.why: the contradiction will recur on the next update

anti_patterns.dont: retain 'always', 'never', commit, push, publish, delete, or force commands as untyped auto-memory mandates
anti_patterns.instead: move approved policy to CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md or label it as dated evidence
anti_patterns.why: historical feedback can override current authorization boundaries

anti_patterns.dont: store endpoints, token commands, credential locations, or secret-bearing examples in memory
anti_patterns.instead: use a redacted pointer to a protected operational runbook
anti_patterns.why: auto-memory is routinely injected and inspectable

preserves.behavior: Claude memory remains Git-repository scoped and shared across worktrees of the same repository
No sensitive value is copied into reports, fixtures, logs, or test snapshots
Topic files remain on-demand rather than bloating every startup context
Useful durable debugging insights such as bounded optional-driver isolation remain available with provenance

prior_art.concept: concise project startup index with topic links
home-directory scope containing unrelated project facts
